paper_title: ARC-SORT: Adaptive, Robust, Compensated Multi-Object Tracking with Interacting Multiple Models

sections.title: Abstract
sections.content: Multi-object tracking in sports broadcasts is hard for two reasons: athletes move fast and change direction abruptly, and the camera pans and zooms at the same time. We present ARC-SORT (Adaptive, Robust, Compensated SORT), a tracking-by-detection tracker that trains nothing and runs in real time. Its design rule: the tracker measures its own uncertainty, and that measurement decides how it acts. An Interacting Multiple Model (IMM) Kalman filter gives every track a predictive covariance, and we turn it into a per-track search region: the less reliable the motion prediction, the larger the region in which a detection may match (uncertainty-adaptive Expansion IoU, EIoU). On identical inputs, this continuous coupling is what matters: the same covariance used as a hard Mahalanobis gate hurts at every threshold we swept, and richer covariance summaries add nothing measurable. When two tracks cross, the assignment cost itself reports whether the decision was close. ARC-SORT keeps such pairs under review and applies at most one corrective identity swap once post-crossing appearance evidence shows the first decision was wrong; this adds +1.0 HOTA (higher order tracking accuracy) on both the SportsMOT and DanceTrack test sets at under a millisecond per frame. For players who leave the frame for seconds, motion extrapolation carries no information, so our offline re-identification drops the usual motion gate and links tracklets by appearance alone. ARC-SORT reaches 81.82 HOTA on the SportsMOT test set with the fewest identity switches of the 69 leaderboard entries as of August 2026 and tied-third multi-object tracking accuracy (MOTA, 97.09), and 62.1 HOTA on DanceTrack test with the same association settings. On Deep-EIoU's public detections and embeddings it reaches 80.31 HOTA, +3.1 over Deep-EIoU. It runs at about 50 frames per second on a laptop RTX 3060 GPU. Code will be released.

Tracking-by-detection splits multi-object tracking (MOT) into two steps: detector finds object boxes in every frame, and an association step links those boxes across frames into tracks that keep their identities. The SORT family [7] performs the second step with Kalman filter, which predicts where each track will be, and matching cost, usually the intersection over union (IoU) between predicted and detected boxes, solved as linear assignment. This paper is about the association step only: ARC-SORT takes the output of fixed detector and trains nothing. Sports broadcasts concentrate the two failure modes of the SORT paradigm into one domain: athletes sprint, cut, and collide, violating the Kalman filters constant-velocity assumption, while the broadcast camera pans and zooms on top. The dominant response is to make association more tolerant, enlarging boxes by fixed margin [43], schedule [20], or velocity heuristic [40], or else to learn motion per domain [3, 22, 27]. Meanwhile, two quantities that report how much the tracker should trust itself are computed every frame and discarded: the filters predictive covariance says how far the motion prediction can be trusted, yet overlap-cost pipelines either ignore it at association time or consume it as hard Mahalanobis veto [42] (ground-plane costs [45] abandon overlap entirely); and the assignments own cost margin says how nearly it preferred the swapped pairing, yet nothing in the trackers state distinguishes confident match from coin flip. This paper is built on single principle: tracker should let its own uncertainty govern its own decisions. We instantiate it twice, as search breadth and commitment firmness, and follow it to its limit. At short horizons the motion covariance acts as tolerance, not veto: our uncertaintyadaptive Expansion IoU dilates each tracks matching region by continuous function of its predictive standard deviation, supplied by an Interacting Multiple Model (IMM) filter [6, 8]. At crossings, the assignment margin governs identity commitment: pair whose swap would cost the assignment almost nothing was decided at the moment of worst evidence, so ARC-SORT marks it entangled, snapshots pre-crossing appearance, accumulates permutation likelihood, and repairs the decision with at most one corrective swap per episode [32]. Past multi-second out-ofview gap (footballs dominant failure; median camera exit 111 frames) the covariance has diverged and search region wider than the frame is no gate at all, so the offline reidentification stage drops the motion gate and lets appearance alone link tracklets. Each part is established by measurement. controlled mechanism ladder on identical cached inputs shows hard Mahalanobis gating on the same covariance degrades association at every threshold we swept, while richer uses add nothing measurable: the scalar relative positional uncertainty is, empirically, sufficient statistic for association tolerance. Deferred commitment is worth +1.0 HOTA on both test servers over the identical system without it, and removing the merges motion veto is worth +4.9 HOTA on SportsMOT val and transfers to DanceTrack under different embedding model. tracker evaluated on leaderboard is evaluated jointly with its detector, so we anchor our comparison in detectordeconfounded protocol: on the exact public detections and embeddings of Deep-EIoU [20], ARC-SORT scores 80.31 HOTA (higher order tracking accuracy [26]) versus their published 77.20, +3.1 margin produced entirely by association, the decisive share from removing the merges motion gate (Sec. 4.2). With our own detector stack ARCSORT reaches 81.82 on the SportsMOT test set (rank 6 of 69 as of August 2026), with the fewest identity switches of any entry (1,414) at tied-third MOTA (97.09) and, despite the 30th-best detection accuracy (DetA), the 4th-best identity F1 (IDF1): association, not detection, produces the result. Our contributions are: 1. Uncertainty-adaptive Expansion IoU: to our knowledge the first IoU-family association tolerance set continuously by the filters own predictive covariance; training-free, one scalar per track per frame (Sec. 3.4). 2. sufficient-statistic characterization: controlled ladder showing the scalar max(σx/w, σy/h) captures everything the covariance offers for association, and that veto-style uses of the same signal hurt (Secs. 3.7, 4.4). 3. Deferred identity commitment: the assignments permutation margin as an online ambiguity signal, converted by two-hypothesis corrective swap into +1.0 test HOTA on two benchmarks at sub-millisecond cost (Secs. 3.6, 4.6). 4. The long-horizon corollary: at multi-second out-ofview gaps the motion prior is the binding constraint; removing it from the offline merge is benchmarkand embedding-general, with every comparison anchored input-identical (Secs. 3.8, 4.5, 4.2). 2. Related Work established Tracking-by-detection. SORT [7] the predictassociate loop; successive work strengthened every stage: appearance and post-hoc refinement [12, 42], low-confidence recovery [47], observation-centric drift correction [9], camera compensation [4], ground-plane modeling [45], adaptive appearance fusion [28], weak cues [44], and track-centric assignment [34]. Across this family, the filters predictive covariance is either ignored at association time or, in practice, consumed solely as hard Mahalanobis gate [42]; the association cost itself is uncertainty-blind, and the assignment is commitment-blind: every match is final the frame it is made. Expanded and buffered matching. Closest to ARCSORT are methods that enlarge boxes before computing overlap: by fixed proportional margin [43], fixed iterative schedule [20] (discarding the Kalman filter), with harmonic cost mean [16], or switched by binary velocity threshold atop trained long short-term memory (LSTM) In every case the factor is fixed or disgated filter [40]. cretely switched; none derives it from the filters own predictive covariance. Ours is continuous function of that covariance, wide exactly when the prediction is unreliable, and requires no training. Uncertainty as signal. In detection, probabilistic-IoU box models [24, 25, 41] score overlap between distributions rather than boxes; UTrack [35] propagates detector uncertainty into association, complementary to the motion-model uncertainty we exploit. IMM filtering [6, 8, 29] has long supplied calibrated predictive covariances in radar tracking, where the probabilistic and joint probabilistic data association filters (PDAF/JPDAF) [5, 13] spend them continuously inside soft filter update. Visual MOTs hard-assignment, overlap-cost pipelines use the covariance only as Mahalanobis veto [42]; covariance as continuous overlap tolerance under one-to-one assignment is, to our knowledge, new. Deferred data association. Multiple hypothesis tracking (MHT) [32] answers ambiguity by not deciding; PDAF/JPDAF (above) soften the assignment itself. Vision revisited both, in pruned MHT with appearance [23], m-best JPDA [33], and near-online revision [10], but the SORT lineage dropped deferral: it commits every identity at the crossing instant, precisely when occlusion makes evidence worst, and revision survives only as offline refinement [12, 38]. Our mechanism (Sec. 3.6) is bounded revival inside the causal stream: the assignments own permutation margin selects the rare entangled pairs, two hypotheses each, at most one corrective swap per episode; 2 to our knowledge no SORT-family tracker on these benchmarks revises committed identity within the causal stream at SORT cost. Learned motion and association. The alternative is to learn: motion networks [19, 21, 22, 27, 31], deep Kalman replacements [2, 3], learned association [1, 36], graphbased online/offline tracking [30], and end-to-end transformers [14, 46], all trained per domain, inheriting their training distribution; ARC-SORT adapts online through the filter, training-free and detector-independent. Offline tracklet association. Closest to our long-horizon stage, GTA [38] refines Deep-EIoU offline, globally relinking tracklets under appearance plus spatio-temporal constraints (81.0 on SportsMOT). Our merge differs in what it removes: it drops the motion constraint at long gaps, the binding factor per our ablation (Sec. 4.5), and links on appearance alone. Foundation-model tracking and benchmarks. At different compute tier, selective mask propagation [18] dispatches SAM 3 video segmenter only where an assignment-uncertainty signal fires (87.2 on SportsMOT, with global association): our premise, uncertainty decides where effort is spent, at fraction of the cost. SportsMOT [11] combines fast, non-linear athlete motion with panning broadcast cameras; DanceTrack [39] isolates non-linear motion under largely static camera, so the pair is controlled test of motion and camera components. 3. Experiments 4.1. Setup Datasets. SportsMOT [11]: 45 val sequences (15 each basketball, football, volleyball) for all tuning and ablations; 150 test sequences evaluated exclusively through the official evaluation server. DanceTrack [39] val (25 sequences) serves as transfer benchmark: non-linear motion under largely static camera. We report HOTA [26] with its detection (DetA) and association (AssA) components, identity F1 (IDF1), multi-object tracking accuracy (MOTA), and the number of identity switches (IDs). Implementation. Nothing in the system is trained. The detector is YOLOX-X [15] with the public SportsMOT weights from the MixSort model zoo [11]. Two releases exist, and we keep them separate: every validation-set experiment and ablation in this paper uses the checkpoint trained on the train split only, so no validation frame was seen by the detector; the test-set submissions use the train+val checkpoint, the release intended for test submissions. Validation-set DetA is therefore not inflated by detector exposure; appearance embeddings come from the sports-domain OSNet released with Deep-EIoU [20] (DanceTrack rows use FastReID SBS-S50 [17]). Association hyperparameters are given in Secs. 3.43.8; the inputidentical runs change only detector-calibration thresholds (τH 0.60.5, spawn 0.70.6, match 0.250.2). All experiments run on single RTX 3060 laptop GPU (6 GB). Detections, embeddings, and camera transforms are cached once, so every ablation shares byte-identical inputs; an md5-verified regression anchor guarantees the baseline configuration reproduces exactly across the campaign. On SportsMOT val the online gain is +0.83 pooled (77.97 78.80; mean persequence delta +0.69, 95% CI [+0.15, +1.32], paired bootstrap) and passes through the chain undiminished (84.12 84.96). Both test servers agree: +1.00 on SportsMOT (80.82 81.82, 95 swaps across 56 of 150 sequences) and +1.00 on DanceTrack (61.1 62.1), each against the byteidentical system without the mechanism. Three finer-grained checks (numbers in Appendix A): the gain lives where crossings do (basketball +1.68; football, whose failures are camera exits, +0.18); perswap ground-truth (GT) audit on SportsMOT val finds 11 verified-correct swaps and none verified-incorrect; and on Deep-EIoUs embeddings the same val experiment measures +1.06, so the margin fires whatever the embedding stack (val gains transfer at 53120% across our two test runs). Identity switches rise under the mechanism (1,238 1,414 on test) because each swap relabels both tracks (95 swaps, +176 switches). The trade is deliberate: bounded mislabeling buys the remainder of both tracks, the association metrics price it correctly (AssA +1.86, IDF1 +1.30), and the count remains the lowest on the leaderboard as of August 2026. 5. Conclusion We presented ARC-SORT, training-free tracker in which the the trackers own uncertainty governs its decisions: IMM covariance sets continuous per-track association tolerance, the assignments permutation margin defers nearambiguous commitments until evidence settles them, and where motion information has run out an appearance-only merge replaces the motion-gated one. Limitations. Deferred commitment is pairwise and single-swap, and its gain tracks the embedding stack (53 120% of the validation delta). The long-horizon stage is offline. Public model-zoo detection caps HOTA. On DanceTrack, 62.1 is well below trained specialists; on SportsMOT, trained and foundation-model systems [18] keep 0.15.4 HOTA edge. Acknowledgments.
